title: Standalone services no longer close their database pool
evidence: services/*/repository.py close_repository now only drops its reference (B-10 part 2); services/dealmaker/main.py, deals/main.py, docugen/main.py call close_repository but none calls shared.mongo.close_all (only app.py does)
impact: In microservice mode each shutdown leaves the pool to the interpreter's exit; harmless on exit, but a reload in dev keeps sockets open
fix: Call shared.mongo.close_all() in every service main's lifespan teardown (one helper)
why_money: fewer Atlas connections in microservice mode
